build_continuous_batching_ios: build a ContinuousBatchingIOs instance to hold inputs and outputs for a continuous batching forward pass with static tensor storage
build_continuous_batching_async_ios: build a ContinuousBatchingAsyncIOs instance to handle async API inputs and outputs using dual host-device IO pairs
build_host_device_io_pair: build a HostDeviceIOPair to manage host-device tensor transfers with CUDA events for synchronization
build_paged_attention_args: build a PagedAttentionArgs dataclass with tensors for a paged attention forward pass
run_prepare_batch_tensors: run prepare_batch_tensors to prepare static tensors and metadata for the next model forward pass from a list of requests
